## Problem

Who is affected, and what cannot be done today?

## Proposed contract

Describe the CLI command, policy field, report field, or workflow behavior you propose. Include a concrete example.

## Alternatives considered

Explain why an existing detector, external tool, or GitHub feature is not sufficient.

## Compatibility and safety

Explain whether this changes JSON output, exit codes, permissions, network access, or the rule that inspected repositories are never executed.
